metadata.name: WAYMARK Education Directory
metadata.description: A starter directory of Indian universities for education discovery.
limitations: This is a starter dataset, not a complete directory of Indian higher education institutions.
Institutional details and admission information should be confirmed with official sources.
No fees, admission deadlines, rankings, or eligibility criteria are asserted by this dataset.
